messages:
Jordan: Quick sync — SDK v2.1 cutover tomorrow 09:00 PT. Need final owners confirmed for sample apps, docs, changelog. Who's on rollback? :eyes:
Anna: I'm docs owner. I can finish quickstarts by 04:00 PT. Will post PR link.
Sam: I'm SDK release owner. CI green. Need Mike to confirm e2e on Dedicated infra.
Mike: Oncall SRE here. I'll run smoke on staging at 06:30 PT and sign off if <500ms median.
Lucy: I'll handle sample apps (node/python) — will bump deps and add changelog snippets.
Jordan: Changelog cutoff = 07:00 PT? We should freeze PRs that touch public APIs at 05:30.
Sam: +1 for 05:30 freeze. Branch protection will be enabled. Will tag release-candidate at 07:15.
Anna: Docs PR: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/312 — embeds, examples. Need a short review from @Sam by 05:00.
Lucy: Sample app PRs: node: https://github.com/redwood/sample-node/pull/78 python: https://github.com/redwood/sample-py/pull/33. They need a small README tweak; I'll do it.
CI-Bot: CI pipeline started for release-candidate — 6 jobs queued.
Jordan: Dependencies: eng-platform is landing a runtime change that might affect packaging. @Sam is this compatible with our wheels?
Sam: Packaging change is backward compatible, but will bump minor. I tested wheel+docker; good.
Mike: Reminder: can we move cutover window earlier if SRE signoff is faster? I can do 05:30 smoke if folks are ready.
Anna: Fine, I'll aim docs by 03:30 then. Saves buffer.
Sam: One blocker: flaky test in streaming tests. CC @Jordan — opened flaky ticket RT-456.
Jordan: I'll take the flaky test. If not fixed by 04:30 we'll toggle the test flag for release.
Lucy: Also need to ensure sample apps are on the public model endpoint not dedicated staging — otherwise examples fail.
Sam: We'll set env var SWITCH_TO_HOSTED=true in sample app CI for the release.
Jordan: Rollback plan: revert tag, roll clients back to v2.0, and re-enable old packaging. Owner: Sam. SRE lead: Mike.
Anna: Post-release tasks: update changelog in release notes page, create blog stub. I'll do blog draft in morning.
Lucy: ETA for sample app smoke: 04:45 PT.
Sam: Final checklist: CI green, docs merged, sample apps smoke, changelog updated, release tag pushed. I'll push unless any objections.
Mike: No objections from SRE. I'll sign off on monitor run at 05:50.
Jordan: OK let's call it: freeze 05:30 PT, smoke start 05:50, tag 07:15, cutover 09:00. Thanks everyone :tada:
Sam: Thanks — I'll post final status updates in #eng-releases and ping CSMs.
